# eVite.lk

> eVite.lk is a Sri Lankan digital wedding invitation platform. Couples create mobile invitation experiences, share links on WhatsApp, collect RSVPs, and use built-in wedding checklist and budget tools in the dashboard. Hosting packs start at Rs. 2,999 (Silver), Rs. 7,999 (Gold), and Rs. 14,999 (Platinum).

## What it is

- Best for: Sri Lankan couples who want WhatsApp-friendly digital wedding invitations plus planning tools.
- Core features: Mobile invitations, RSVP, checklist, budget tracker, guest management.
- Pricing model: Hosting packs with digital invites; Gold and Platinum include printed card bundles.
- Contact: info@evite.lk, 071 656 1975, Warakapola, Sri Lanka.
